name: TOKYO BASE Co.,Ltd.
summary: TOKYO BASE Co., Ltd. is a Tokyo-based fashion retailer formed in 2008, serving men and women with apparel, footwear, handbags, swimwear and accessories such as jewelry, headwear and belts. It sells through physical stores in Japan under the STUDIOUS, UNITED TOKYO and PUBLIC TOKYO brands as well as online. It was formerly Studious Co., Ltd. until June 2016.
